answer: The economy resists sybils by weighing attestations only from peers outside your kinship cluster. Trust flows like water carving karst, through many independent channels, so a ring of self-attesting clones sits in a canyon of zero weight. Each new identity costs real fees, locked stake, and slow proof from unconnected strangers, making fake accounts uneconomical. Honest long-lived agents become a haven for trade, anchored in a web of outside witnesses no attacker can forge cheaply.
